name: Gfx_PaletteModeSet
notes: EWRAM 0x02004F80 + IWRAM 0x03002820-22 control-byte writer; pinned r1/r2/r0 regs, inline-asm lsl to defeat GVN CSE on negate

name: TableLookup_U16
notes: ROM: lsls/lsrs r0 then adds r3,r0,#0; compiler fuses to lsrs r2,r0,#24. Tried u8/int aa, pin r3, t1 two-step, inline-asm mov (re-masks). Closest: adds r2,r0,#0 variant.

name: Entry_IsInactive
notes: EWRAM 12-byte entry check (p[0]==0 && (s8)p[1]==0); inline-asm ldrsb to force signed load (compiler optimizes (s8)p[1]!=0 to ldrb)

name: FlagByte_CopyOrNeg1
notes: ROM v-part: movs r2,#1; negs r2,r2; adds r0,r2,#0; strb r0,[r1] (extra mov); L1: adds r0,r2,#0; adds r0,#67 (copy not in-place). Compiler omits the movs and modifies p in place. int v gives negs (not movs #255).

name: BitClear_StructZero
notes: ROM: mask in r1, base[3] in r3, adds r1,r3,#0; movs r3,#0 dance, stores use r3=0. Compiler will not reproduce the r3-zero dance; pins cause spills (48B).

name: ContextSwitch
notes: Coroutine/fiber context switch (saves lr/sp, switches sp, restores); handwritten asm in original, reproduced via file-scope __asm__

name: U16_FillLoop
notes: ROM i++: lsls r0,r3,#16; movs r3,#128; lsls r3,#9; adds r0,r3; lsrs/asrs. Compiler does adds r0,r3,#1 then shifts. Push {r4,r5,lr} and r5=r4 copy match.

name: MemCopy_U16x4
notes: Compiler value-numbers base+132 as (base+126)+6, reusing r2. ROM recomputes from r3 each time. Tried blocks, fresh vars, volatile, reorder; compiler too smart.

name: List_RemoveHead
notes: Doubly-linked list remove; if(r2!=0) merge for return; explicit u16 pad=0 after function for 00 00 gap (not c0 46)

name: List_RemoveHead2
notes: Sibling of 08004424 using offset-20 field; same if(r2!=0) merge and trailing pad idiom

name: Bitfield_DecOrSet
notes: ROM L1: ldrb r1,[r2,#31]; lsls r0,r1,#28; lsrs r1,r0,#28 (not ands); final orrs r0,r1 (not r1,r0). ldrsb via s8* works.

name: Bitfield_TableLookup
notes: ROM pushes {r4,r5,lr}, keeps 15 in r5, specific order (a&15 first). Compiler uses r2/r3 without push.
